crops.kind: Exact saved 24x24 uint8 crops on accepted frames; missing input is zero

heat.display_encoding: Per-frame max normalized to 255 for visibility; not model input values

provenance.original_scene: No original full-frame simulation video was saved. Court and shuttle are a calibrated explanatory rendering. The small crop is the actual saved model input.
provenance.observations: Actual saved normal-condition synthetic observation mask, crop and heatmap; not a new detector run.
provenance.labels_usage: Evaluation and separate green reference only. Blue coordinates are the saved network prediction.
provenance.selection: Selected retrospectively for demonstration from 128 test rallies x 2 views; low-error complete example, not an independent test or average result. Replaces a poor real demonstration without claiming real depth improvement.
